title: MushR: A Smart, Automated, and Scalable Indoor Harvesting System for Gourmet Mushrooms
authors: Anant Sujatanagarjuna; Shohreh Kia; Dominique Fabio Briechle; Benjamin Leiding
notes: Mask R-CNN maturity recognition; not-ready/ready/overdue fruitbody classes; DBSCAN-based flush grouping and area-weighted cluster maturity; Detectron2.

title: M18K: A Multi-Purpose Real-World Dataset for Mushroom Detection, 3D Pose Estimation, and Growth Monitoring
notes: Button mushroom data; RGB-D, instance segmentation, 3D-pose and growth/yield subsets. Existing repo experiment uses a separately indexed V2 export.

title: A novel Mask R-CNN-based tracking pipeline for oyster mushroom cluster growth monitoring in time-lapse image datasets
authors: Christos Charisis; Sari Nuwayhid; Dimitrios Argyropoulos
notes: Primary tracking reference: ConvNeXt-Tiny/Swin backbones, post-processing, mask-based baseline association, track retention through missing detections and growth visualization.

title: Real-Time Detection and Instance Segmentation Models for the Growth Stages of Pleurotus pulmonarius for Environmental Control in Mushroom Houses
authors: Can Wang; Xinhui Wu; Zhaoquan Wang; Han Shao; Dapeng Ye; Xiangzeng Kong
notes: 1,261 images and seven developmental stages; use as stage-taxonomy/model-design reference, not as a required training source.

title: A novel dataset of annotated oyster mushroom images with environmental context for machine learning applications
authors: Sonay Duman; Abdullah Elewi; Abdulsalam Hajhamed; Rasheed Khankan; Amina Souag; Asma Ahmed
notes: Bibliographic identity retained only to document the source identifier listed in D001. Do not use the associated dataset, labels, sensor records or any dataset-derived conclusions.

title: MushroomSegDepth: A multitask model for segmentation and depth prediction of oyster mushrooms to support growth management
authors: Meiqing Wang; Sari Nuwayhid; Dimitrios Argyropoulos
notes: RGB-only multitask segmentation/depth approach; 705 RGB-depth pairs reported; dataset not publicly linked in repository/paper record checked.
